bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls for regulated insurers adopting analytics and ML, establishing governance patterns that let security-conscious customers deploy production AI workloads with confidence.
Built shared responsibility operating-model framing that clarified AWS-owned versus insurer-owned controls, giving regulated customers a repeatable decision framework for safe adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, converting legacy environments into cloud-ready architectures for regulated enterprises.
